claims.text: The FDA chlorpromazine label describes possible additive effects and hypotension with alcohol.
claims.quote: The use of alcohol with this drug should be avoided due to possible additive effects and hypotension.

claims.text: A double-blind crossover trial in 20 healthy volunteers found impaired reactions, proprioception, and coordination with chlorpromazine and alcohol.
claims.quote: The combined administration of CPZ and alcohol led to inaccuracy, a slowing of reactions and impaired proprioception and coordination.

headline.text: The FDA chlorpromazine label describes possible additive effects and hypotension with alcohol.

reported.text: The FDA label describes possible hypotension with the combination.
